# Pocketsfull — Full Site Index

> Pocketsfull is a rewards and earning platform where users earn money by taking paid online surveys, playing free games, and completing offers, then redeem their earnings as gift cards from thousands of global brands. The site operates in 268 country-language locale variations (plus a default locale-less version), each serving region-specific content and gift card availability.

## How this file is organized

This index lists every page on pocketsfull.com (11,547 URLs). Pages are grouped by locale; within each locale they appear in this order: Home, Earn opportunities, Help and Information, Legal, Gift card catalog index, and individual gift card products available in that locale. A small number of URLs have no locale prefix (root-level pages) and are listed in their own section at the end. Every URL is self-canonical: distinct locale variations serve different language and regional content and are not duplicates of one another.
